mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_order (order_no, type, biz_type, related_no, status, total_qty, total_amount, remark, operator_id, operator_name) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{type}, #{bizType}, #{relatedNo}, #{status}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, type, biz_type, related_no, status, total_qty, total_amount, remark, operator_id, operator_name, create_time, update_time FROM stock_order WHERE related_no = #{relatedNo} AND type = #{type} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
